title: Payment of benefits.
bodyText: Additional unemployment benefits are payable from the fund to unemployed claimants who are eligible under this chapter.
bodyHtml: §385-3  Payment of benefits.  Additional unemployment benefits are payable from the fund to unemployed claimants who are eligible under this chapter. [L 1961, c 157, pt of §1; Supp, §93B-4; HRS §385-3]
